intent: enterprise Phase 2: ingest APIs + Claude Code transcripts pull CLI end-to-end
notes: Add `POST /api/v1/commits/ingest` (`enterprise/app/routes/ingest.py`) — batch upsert of local git commits per D11. Idempotent by `(organization_id, repo_identifier, commit_sha)`; returns per-item `created`/`updated`/`unchanged`. `_dt_equal` helper normalizes naive-vs-aware datetime comparisons so re-ingest of already-stored `committed_at` doesn't spuriously flip `unchanged` → `updated`.

Add `POST /api/v1/transcripts/ingest` (same file) — accepts base64 body with `content_encoding: raw|gzip`; decodes → `BlobStore.put` → upserts `transcript_sessions` row → runs linkage inline. Idempotent by `(org, machine, vendor, vendor_session_id)`; re-ingest with different content rewrites blob and refreshes `last_seen_at`.

Add ingest-time linkage algorithm (`ingest.py::_run_linkage`) implementing MVP bases `exact_sha_in_transcript` (scan first 4MB for 7-40 char hex, unique-prefix commit lookup, ambiguous 2+ matches skip) and `session_id_in_snippet` (transcript's `vendor_session_id` == `commits.transcript_session_id`). Per-call `seen_pairs` set dedupes same-transcript multiple SHA hits before flush — TRIPWIRE regression: real transcripts often reference the same commit as both full SHA and one or more prefix forms.

Add read endpoints (`enterprise/app/routes/transcripts.py`): `GET /api/v1/transcripts` (paginated list + `linked_commit_count` via group-by join); `GET /api/v1/transcripts/{id}` (session + links inline); `GET /api/v1/transcripts/{id}/blob` (64KB streaming + `X-Blob-Sha256` header); `GET /api/v1/commits/{sha}/transcripts` (reverse lookup, 7-40 char SHA prefix).

Fix `Commit` ORM model (`enterprise/app/models/commit.py`): Migration 008 added the `transcript_session_id` column but the `Commit` class was never updated to include it. Added the mapped column so writes route through SQLAlchemy instrumentation (rather than `__dict__` bypass) and reads work naturally.

Add Claude Code transcript discovery (`enterprise/enterprise-cli/gator_enterprise_cli/transcripts_discovery.py`): walks `~/.claude/projects/<hash>/<uuid>.jsonl` line-by-line (sessions run 100s of MB), extracts sessionId + model + cwd + timestamp span + turn count. Malformed lines skip individually. `--since` filter compares against `ended_at or started_at`. Env override `CLAUDE_TRANSCRIPTS_ROOT` for tests. Vendor dispatch: `claude`/`anthropic` → same handler. TRIPWIRE: JSONL format is not a documented API.

Add `gator-enterprise transcripts pull` (`enterprise/enterprise-cli/gator_enterprise_cli/commands/transcripts.py`): four-step sequence — read `~/.gator/dashboard-repos.json` + `~/.gator/machine-id`, iterate repos via git log + `.gator/session-snippets/*.json`; POST commit batch (`repo_canonical_id = local/<basename>`); discover transcripts; upload each (gzip default). Snippet-recorded `transcript_session_id`/`machine_id`/`agent` flow into commit payload so session-id linkage lights up server-side. Flags: `--vendor`/`--since`/`--dry-run`/`--limit`/`--commits-per-repo`/`--no-compress`. Also `transcripts list` for smoke-test surface. ASCII-only output on Windows (cp1252 stdout can't render `→`).
Wire routers in `enterprise/app/main.py` (ingest + transcripts) and register the CLI subcommand in `enterprise/enterprise-cli/gator_enterprise_cli/main.py`.
